response.original_title: How to Escalate a Travelocity Complaint: Customer Service, Booking, Cancellation & Refund Help
response.overview: To escalate an issue with Travelocity, call their customer support at +1-855-473-9012(US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) and explicitly ask the initial representative to transfer your call to a supervisor or the tier-two escalation desk  You can reach Travelocity customer support for help or to request an escalation at +1-855-473-9012(US)  How to Escalate an IssueCall Support: Dial +1-855-473-9012(US) to speak with a frontline customer service representativ Request a Supervisor: Explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor, tier-two agent, or escalation desk if the first agent cannot fix your problem.
